claims.label: Theorem 4.3
claims.statement_original:
Under Assumption B and $H_0$, in $\mathcal H_K^*$,
\[
\widehat R_n\Longrightarrow R_\infty,
\]
where $R_\infty(a)=\sum_{j=1}^\infty\lambda_j\langle\varphi_j,\Pi a\rangle_{K^\perp}U_j$. Thus, under these conditions $n\widehat Q_K^\perp\xrightarrow{d}\sum_{j=1}^\infty\lambda_jU_j^2$.
